notes.title: Full Game Release Coming May 2nd!
notes.notes:
Come One, Come All! We will be leaving Early Access on May 2nd with the [b]release of the full game[/b]! 

This has been an incredible journey developing[i] No Strings Attached[/i], and we couldn't have done it without fans like you! Thank you for your support and comments during Early Access. We can't wait to see what you all think of the final game!


Please look forward to the game's full release on [b]May 2nd[/b]!
